name: Spiral
author: Airwindows (Chris Johnson, MIT licence)
description: Airwindows Spiral by Chris Johnson: the smoothest clipping curve - loud peaks roll over sweetly instead of breaking up. Ported from Airwindows (MIT licence).
code:
// Airwindows Spiral, Copyright (c) 2018 Chris Johnson, MIT licence (LICENSE-airwindows.txt) - ported to Central FX
@block
gi = db2gain(input)
go = db2gain(output)
@sample
xL = inL * gi
aL = abs(xL)
xL = aL == 0 ? 0 : sin(xL * aL) / aL
xR = inR * gi
aR = abs(xR)
xR = aR == 0 ? 0 : sin(xR * aR) / aR
outL = xL * go * mix + inL * (1 - mix)
outR = xR * go * mix + inR * (1 - mix)
